note: H106: a shared executable replaced by an in-place truncating write. Both falsifiers survived; install_hooks.sh v3 ships the rename(2) installer and a deterministic inode selfcheck.

controls.name: C1_executor_actually_ran
controls.must_fire_because: each arm must be shown to have parsed the script successfully many times, or a zero-failure arm is an executor that never executed
controls.can_fail_because: an arm with zero successful parses
controls.null_must_contain: successes and failures both, which the cp arms produce

observations.what_would_fail_it: an arm with zero successful parses, which would make a zero-failure verdict an executor that never executed (A15)

controls.name: C2_writer_actually_wrote
controls.must_fire_because: each arm must be shown to have rewritten the live file, or the comparison is a no-op
controls.null_must_contain: a non-zero write count under both installers

observations.what_would_fail_it: an arm with zero writes, which would make the whole comparison a no-op

controls.name: C3_cp_arm_reproduces_its_own_sign
controls.must_fire_because: two independent cp runs must agree on whether failures occur at all, or the effect is not reportable
controls.can_fail_because: one cp run failing and the other not
controls.null_must_contain: both signs: an arm is free to come out at zero

observations.what_would_fail_it: the two cp runs disagreeing about whether failures occur at all, which would make the rate unreportable

falsifiers.name: F1_cp_never_produces_a_partial_read
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the cp arms produce zero parse failures across every execution
falsifiers.null_must_contain: zero failures, which the mv arm demonstrates this harness can report
